The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 10062 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 6 June - the folder's feast day. Captioned Ilarion and filed under Category:Hilarion the New of Dalmatia - the abbot of the Dalmatou monastery named in this folder's slug and office. The other plates of the day are Vissarion and a group of three women.
